results.title: Iran 68
results.overview: The film is about a character named Omid who, after turning 40, still does not have a proper job and enters a new space in the upper part of the city in order to progress, where different situations arise for him

results.title: Woke
results.overview: A vampire from over two centuries ago joins a clandestine 12-step program called Feeders Anonymous and attempts to recover from her supernatural addiction.

results.title: Moonlighters
results.overview: A call center applicant manipulates time during his interview only to find out his interviewer could do the same. The two become stuck in a limbo as they accidentally stop time at the same moment, leading them to confront the frozen world together.

results.title: Midnight
results.overview: The night before an important audition, Laney misses the bus home. Trying to make it to her audition, Laney encounters a cast of increasingly strange and whimsical characters.

results.title: Mentors
results.overview: MENTORII follows the story of Johnny Balta, an immature young man and future heir to a vast financial empire owned by his father, Dorin Balta. Dissatisfied with his son's superficial behavior, Dorin decides to kick him out of the house after a car accident and gives him six months to prove that he can become a responsible adult. With the help of his sister Magda, Johnny seeks mentorship from the country's three most famous personal development influencers. From there, things take an unexpected turn...

results.title: Prisoners of Paradise
results.overview: Love was their greatest rebellion. Set on the enchanting island of Mauritius in 1925, recently orphaned Lucy is sent to live with her charming but controlling uncle. When she defies his plans to marry her off for financial gain, she falls deeply in love with Krishna, a handsome local worker. But the world has other plans, and Lucy and Krishna must risk everything and defy the forces determined to tear them apart.  Starring Ellie Bamber (William Tell, The Serpent), Rhona Mitra (Hollow Man, Red Sonja), Rupert Penry-Jones (Match Point, Spooks), Mehdi Dehbi (Messiah). Directed by Mitch Jenkins (A Million Days, The Show).  Inspired by the lives of Alan and Maria Govinden and the book 'Prisoner of Paradise' written by Romesh Gunesekera.

results.title: Hearts Around the Table: Josh's Third Serving
results.original_title: Hearts Around the Table: Josh's Third Serving
results.overview: When after school programs see their funding cut, Teachers Josh and Ella turn to fundraising before banding together in search of a larger donation, falling hard along the way.

results.title: The Bhootnii
results.overview: The Virgin Tree, based in the heart of St. Vincent's College, is home to a spirit who awakens every Valentine's Day  in response to the longing for true love. As strange incidents multiply, the Virgin Tree becomes a place of dread,  the authorities call in a veteran para-physicist to confront the entity.

results.title: Maysa
results.overview: Maysa unfolds over a single afternoon as a young woman and her stoic middle eastern mother navigate the quiet tension of a long-held silence. As memories of migration and girlhood surface in fractured flashbacks, their unspoken history begins to unravel. A tender, restrained portrait of love, resilience, and the things women carry - even when they no longer have to.

results.title: Tales of the Bizarre: 35th Anniversary Special
results.original_title: 世にも奇妙な物語35周年SP ～伝説の名作 一夜限りの復活編～
results.overview: To commemorate the 35th anniversary of the popular omnibus drama "Tales of the Unusual," in which Tamori serves as the storyteller, "Tales of the Tales of the Unusual 35th Anniversary Special: Legendary Masterpieces One Night Only Revival Edition" will be broadcast on Fuji TV's "Saturday Premium" slot (Saturday 9pm) on May 31st. The program will feature five of Tamori's most famous works from the series' past.  The programs that will be broadcast on the 31st are as follows:  "BLACK ROOM" (broadcast in 2001, starring Takuya Kimura)  "The Night Train Man" (broadcast in 2002, starring Ren Osugi)  "Locker" (broadcast in 1990, starring Yuji Oda)  "Bijokan" (broadcast in 2005, starring Satoshi Tsumabuki)  "Memories of Love, Don't Stop" (broadcast in 2019, starring Yuki Saito)

results.title: Raptures
results.overview: Rakel is a strict Christian believer living in the far north of 1930s Sweden. When her husband forms a sectarian movement, with directions straight from God, she has no choice but to join the increasingly explicit cult.

results.title: R.I.C.O. Detroit
results.overview: In the shadows of fame, where microphones hide murder and every chorus carries a secret. World reigns supreme, a criminal genius cloaked in diamonds, running a record label that launders millions and bleeds the streets dry.The deadly intersection of music and murder, where platinum records hide blood money and every beat masks a body count.

results.title: Ram Abdullah Antony
results.overview: School studenty Antonys mother works as a beedi maker and dies of cancer due to her work. Gurumoorthy,a rowdy in the village,comes to run the beedi factory. So Antony and his friends Ram and Abdullah join forces to demand the closure of the beedi factory.

results.title: Mimi au pays du métal
results.overview: Between the hydraulic press and the plasma saw, Mimi, a young factory worker, dreams of escaping in the sun with her two best friends Iris and Chris. When their boss Mister Babin refuses to grant them their leave, Mimi is ready to do anything to make him change his mind.

results.title: The Forest Through the Trees
results.overview: Chloe and her step dad, Ken are dealing with the disappearance of Kathy, Chloe's mother and Ken's wife. After a painful year, and with the help of Chloe's friend Ava, they investigate a clue that leads them to a terrifying demon cult.

results.title: The Singing Children
results.overview: In 1988, four residents of a juvenile detention center planned to defraud the Buenos Aires Provincial Lottery.

results.title: Trouble sur le rail
results.overview: Annoyed after a meeting with her producer, Gemma sits next to the confident Joel on the train. Then her 9-year-old son calls to say he wants to wear a dress to school the next day.

results.title: Boys
results.overview: Teo and his friends are boys who believe to be far from the most toxic forms of masculinity. Still, any game, without measuring the space they occupy, is an excuse to be violent with each other. One summer day, they take the game to the limit.
